scope: Fix for the Fx0 display startup reset; removal of the initramfs display hold and the tinydm UI gate
cause: lk2nd hands over a running MDSS scanout, but nothing in Linux claimed the MDSS GDSC or the MDSS AHB/AXI/MDP clocks for it. The built-in MDP IOMMU runtime-suspends (dropping the shared AHB/AXI clocks and letting genpd switch MDSS_GDSC off) before msm's MDSS/DSI probe, so the first DSI register read (earlier traced to offset 0x1f0, data abort) hits an unclocked or unpowered block and the phone resets. Holding either MDSS or the IOMMU runtime-active kept the shared domain and clocks on, which is why either hold sufficed.

fix.fx0-linux: 683f457c18f4 on integration/fx0-display-handoff (r14 + board DTS): /chosen simple-framebuffer node, status disabled, with power-domains <&mmcc MDSS_GDSC> and clocks MDSS_AHB/AXI/MDP; lk2nd reuses an existing simple-framebuffer node (lk2nd/display/simplefb.c), fills it in and enables it; simpledrm holds the domain and clocks until msm DRM removes it. Same pattern as the upstream Microsoft and Falcon MSM8226 DTs.

ab_test_ram_boots.method: installed kernel/initramfs, rdinit=/init.fx0-original to bypass the hold wrapper; control rdinit=/init (hold) boots
ab_test_ram_boots.without_node: 2 of 2 reset before the root filesystem (one with lk2nd autorefresh, one without; autorefresh is not the cause)
ab_test_ram_boots.with_node: 6 of 6 boot: system running, taint 0, msmdrmfb, MDSS and IOMMU runtime PM auto

installed.kept: /etc/mkinitfs/modules/99-fx0-display.modules (panel, WLED, touch in the initramfs; ordinary early-display setup for the device package)
installed.backups: local/before-hold-removal and /var/lib/fx0-fallback/before-hold-removal; r14 boot files in local/before-native-r15
installed.owner_check: Sxmo visible and touch works after the first unattended hold-free boot

repetitions.criteria: new boot ID; systemd running; taint 0; no failed units; root p35; both remoteprocs; sound card; msmdrmfb; no hold files; MDSS runtime PM auto; tinydm active and sway running without a manual start
